title: Duration of Free Morning Off-peak Rail Rides Scheme on North East Line
what_it_is: Duration of Free Morning Off-peak Rail Rides Scheme on North East Line

sections.label: Free off-peak travel programme
sections.summary: The free morning off-peak travel programme aims to reduce peak hour crowding and is piloted on the North East Line and Sengkang-Punggol LRT.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: The new free morning off-peak travel programme is intended to reduce peak hour crowding.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: We are piloting the free off-peak travel programme on the North East Line (NEL) and Sengkang-Punggol Light Rail Transit (LRT), which is currently the most well-used section of our Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) network.

sections.label: Funding and assessment of scheme
sections.summary: A similar 2013 programme shifted about 7% of commuters out of the morning peak; the new programme is fully Government-funded and assessed after a year.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: When we introduced a similar free travel programme in 2013, about 7% of commuters shifted out of the morning peak.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: The free morning off-peak travel programme will be fully funded by the Government.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: The level of Government funding required will depend on the eventual take-up rate and therefore, the effectiveness of the scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: We will assess after a year before deciding whether to extend the scheme further.

sections.label: Train loading and crowding
sections.summary: Trains are not filled to the maximum because commuters do not board when too crowded, with loading around four passengers per sqm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: In practice, the trains are not filled to the maximum because commuters decide not to board the train if it gets too crowded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: But today, when we track the loading of the trains, it is in and around four passengers per sqm, which is not anywhere near the operating performance standard.

sections.label: Longer trains not taken
sections.summary: Singapore has not used longer trains because most lines are underground, requiring station expansion or raising fire safety concerns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: In Singapore, we have not taken this step because most of our train lines are underground and if we have trains that are longer than the station length, firstly, you either have to shut down the line to expand the station or there would be fire safety considerations because the carriages that do not have the exit doors, passengers would have to come through a longer way to get out and typically, that is not recommended for us to do that.

sections.label: MRT line construction time
sections.summary: Building an MRT line takes about 15 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: The time frames are long for an MRT line – it takes about 15 years to build.

sections.label: Evaluating the scheme after a year
sections.summary: After a year the scheme will be evaluated, and depending on results it may continue, be extended, have parameters adjusted, or become permanent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: As for whether or not, we will proceed with the scheme after a year, let us evaluate the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: The 7% was based off a previous scheme which had very different parameters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: But roughly, if we hit something like that, I think we can think about whether or not to either continue with the scheme, extend it in its current form or adjust the parameters further or even fold it as a permanent feature into the system.

sections.label: NEL scheme two reasons
sections.summary: The scheme applies to the NEL for two reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: The scheme applies to the NEL for two reasons.
